summary: Max Verstappen won the Mexico City Grand Prix, capitalizing on Ferrari's internal conflict as the Scuderia's drivers collided while fighting for position. The collision between Ferrari's drivers sparked heated recriminations within the team, with sources describing "utter chaos" in the camp after the self-inflicted loss. Kimi Antonelli clinched the world championship despite not winning the race, becoming Formula 1's youngest ever champion and reshaping the title picture with Verstappen's victory.
